text:
Ethan: Quick announce — Vectra Streamline is GA on Hosted API today. Its a model+endpoint combo tuned for short-turn tool-extractive flows with adaptive packetization and priority routing. Opt-in via Console > Endpoints now. :tada:

Rina: Nice! Is this aimed at tool-heavy assistants or low-power clients?

Ethan: Both. Vectra Streamline reduces median TTFB ~35% for tool-backed responses and includes a mobile-optimized mode that trades throughput for smaller packet sizes.

Samir: Ops heads-up: we'll start canaries in us-east-1 for 6h. I added a checklist to the runtime runbook and a synthetic that validates tool coherence + packet reassembly.

ops-bot: ops-bot: rollout/vectra-streamline-ga: canary started (us-east-1) at 2976543230, canary_replicas=3.

Ethan: Migration notes: new endpoint `/v1/vectra/stream`. New query params: `adaptive=true|false`, `priority=low|normal|high` and `mobile_hint=true|false`. SDKs have non-breaking patches that expose `on_packet` hooks.

Rina: Example curl for docs?

Ethan: Short example:

Ethan: ```bash
Ethan: curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
Ethan:   -d '{"model":"vectra-slim-1","adaptive":true,"priority":"high","tools":["kb-search","calendar"]}' \
Ethan:   https://api.redwood.ai/v1/vectra/stream
Ethan: ```

docs-bot: docs-bot: docs/vectra-streamline published at https://console.redwood.ai/docs/vectra-streamline  includes migration guide, examples, and quota info.

Samir: Monitoring additions: packet_reassembly_failures, priority-queue latency P95, mobile_packet_saturation. Alerts set for any packet_reassembly_failures > 0.5% in canary.

Ethan: Billing: Vectra uses `stream_packets` accounting (packets * effective_size). Default quota: 20 streaming rps, mobile packet cap 512KB/min. Customers can request quota increases via Console.

Rina: Any deprecations?

Ethan: We will deprecate `toolstream-v0` in 70 days. Migration helper available to convert streaming frames to vectra packets; auto-routing only for opt-in customers. Full timeline in the docs.

ops-bot: ops-bot: rollout/vectra-streamline-ga: canary health=ok (2976543305). proceeding to eu-west-1 canary next.

Samir: I'll post a short support playbook and host a 15-min Q&A tomorrow 11am PT.

Ethan: Thanks everyone  watch #eng-runtime for regressions and tag me for escalations. :rocket:
